scope: Oracle geometry; offline SE(2) kinematic feasibility
frozen_dynamic_geometry: Use actual dynamic/spawn.json obstacle; no adaptive placement or time-dependent appearance in search

search.method: Existing continuous SE(2) Hybrid A* with quantized duplicate pruning
search.goal: Existing world XY goal disk, radius .30m; no terminal yaw constraint
search.obstacle_rule: Existing continuous swept_clearance lower bound >= .02m with radius .09m

execution: Four raw states in listed run order, spawn then final; B0 then B1 then B2; one search each, no tuning/retry
clock_note: Phase 0-A default was 120 wall seconds. Phase B explicitly uses 120 process CPU seconds; both CPU and wall time are recorded. Other search settings unchanged.
witness: Recheck every entire .5s primitive with original continuous swept/corridor functions; distance integrates abs(v), not signed displacement
interpretation: NO_PATH_FOUND is bounded-search negative evidence, not a proof of geometric or kinematic impossibility. First weighted-search witness is not an optimum.
online_recovery_policy: In-place rotation first; reverse disabled. Reverse permitted only in this offline B2 comparison.
